summary: Fixed the picker sync allow-list post-filter (directory-name vs. basename key mismatch that silently dropped all 23 core skills), generalizing it to a subdir-anchored path-segment match with basename fallback. Added a zero-result wipeout detector and a permanent regression spec. Verified all 6 phases against scratch trees; performed one deliberate redeploy confirming all provides.skills entries deployed and both hand-corrected orchestrator SKILL.md files unchanged.
decisions_made: Anchored the generalized allow-list match on the scanned subdir argument, not filter_category, since they diverge for OpenCode agents (agents_subdir == 'agent/subagents')
Added a basename fallback so a future divergent call site degrades to prior behavior instead of a silent wipeout
Wipeout detector triggers strictly on #results > 0 and #filtered == 0, report-only via helpers.notify WARN
Corrected Phase 2's research premise: scripts/tests and scripts/lint ARE declared in provides.scripts today, but still fail via a third, distinct mismatch mechanism out of this task's scope
